# discord_member_permissions (Data Source)

Reads a member's permissions as Discord computes them from all of the member's roles and `@everyone`, including member-specific overwrites in a channel. When `channel_id` is set, the channel's permission overwrites are applied; threads use their parent channel's overwrites. Reading a channel requires the bot to have `VIEW_CHANNEL` there, and `CONNECT` as well in voice and stage channels. See [Get Guild Member Permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/guild#get-guild-member-permissions) and [Get Channel Member Permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/channel#get-channel-member-permissions).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_current_user" "bot" {}

# The bot's permissions across the server.
data "discord_member_permissions" "bot" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  user_id   = data.discord_current_user.bot.id
}

# The bot's permissions in one channel, after its permission overwrites.
data "discord_member_permissions" "bot_announcements" {
  server_id  = var.server_id
  user_id    = data.discord_current_user.bot.id
  channel_id = var.announcements_channel_id
}

check "bot_can_post_announcements" {
  assert {
    condition     = contains(data.discord_member_permissions.bot_announcements.permission_names, "SEND_MESSAGES")
    error_message = "The bot cannot send messages in the announcements channel."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).
- `user_id` (String) ID of the member's user.

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) ID of a channel or thread to compute the permissions in. Omit for server-level permissions.
- `implicit` (Boolean) Whether Discord masks the permissions that a missing `VIEW_CHANNEL`, or a missing `CONNECT` in a voice or stage channel, makes unusable (see [implicit permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/topics/permissions#implicit-permissions)). Requires `channel_id`. Defaults to `true`. Discord never masks the permissions of bot members.

### Read-Only

- `permission_names` (Set of String) Names of the permission flags set in `permissions`, such as `VIEW_CHANNEL`. Flags this provider does not know are omitted.
- `permissions` (String) The computed permissions as a decimal bitfield string.
